_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. bind_address 0.0.0.0 hosts the whole LAN so several PCs share one leaderboard; 127.0.0.1 is solo.
_games_comment: Per-game GameSpy identifiers, keyed by the lowercase wire gamename. Override or add titles here. secret_key and gameid are not read by the current GPCM/Auth/Sake path; they matter to a future ServerBrowser or enctypex path.
